text:
The nightly job failed last night because the disk ran out of space. The volume was at 98%, which left the job no room to run.

Log rotation has been off since January, so logs have been piling up with nothing clearing them out. Last night they finally filled the disk.

I freed up about 40 GB and reran the job by hand. The rerun finished at 02:40, so last night's output should be complete.

To keep this from happening again, I'd suggest:
- Turn log rotation back on.
- Add a disk usage alert, maybe at 85%, so we hear about it well before anything breaks.
- Find out why rotation was turned off in January. It may have been on purpose, and something could depend on it.

I can take the rotation fix if nobody else is already on it. If anyone wants the details of what I cleaned up, just ask.
